pages.text: Puts a value into the I/O blocks as a variable item.

Each bound I/O block with an uninitialized variable item in its input gets the value. The item moves to the output. It is named after $(1)name$(). Without $(1)name$(), it is named after the variable, like $(1)count$() for $(1)PARAMETER value count ;$(). Otherwise it is named $(1)output$().
If no bound I/O block has an uninitialized variable item, the cursor waits until a player puts one in. Laptops and tablets don't take part in WRITE.
$(li)$(1)value$() any type: the value to write$(li)$(1)name$() STRING: the name of the item (optional)
$(1)CALL WRITE$(br)  PARAMETER value count + step ;$(br)  PARAMETER name "total" ;$()
